description: This file defines a templated base class 'PeriodicController' that inherits from 'ThreadController'. It provides a framework for classes that need to perform periodic work, such as running control loops at specific frequencies. The class manages timing and scheduling, including setup hooks like 'OnStarted()' and a pure virtual method 'PeriodicTask()' meant to be overridden by derived classes. It encapsulates thread management and precise timing to ensure consistent execution intervals.

classes.name: PeriodicController
classes.description: A templated base class for creating controllers that need to run periodic tasks at a specified frequency, handling thread management and timing.

methods.name: OnStarted
methods.description: Hook method called before starting periodic work; can be overridden for setup.

methods.name: PeriodicTask
methods.description: Pure virtual method intended for subclasses to implement the periodic work logic.

methods.name: ThreadTask
methods.description: Override of the threading function that manages timing, calls 'OnStarted()' once, and repeatedly executes 'PeriodicTask()' at the specified interval.

methods.name: PeriodicController (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a name, priority, and desired frequency; calculates the appropriate time period for scheduling.
